title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Nickboss…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Nickboss WordPress File Upload plugin (wp-file-upload) affecting versions up to 5.2.3. This vulnerability results from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing malicious scripts to be stored and executed in users' browsers.
